errors.evidence: The pie chart contains five sectors, not four. The fifth, light blue sector for "Обезщетения" (Indemnities/Compensation) is completely omitted.

errors.evidence: The blue sector corresponds to "Законодателна рамка" (Legislative framework) in the legend and has a value of 40.5%. "Условия за плащане" (Payment terms) corresponds to the gray sector.

errors.text_span: оранжевият сектор, маркиран като "Баланс на риска между страните", занимава 26.2%
errors.evidence: The orange sector ("Баланс на риска между страните") is 19.0% according to the chart. The value 26.2% belongs to the yellow sector ("Решаване на спорове").

errors.text_span: Жълтият сектор, обозначен като "Решаване на спорове" представлява приблизително 19.0% от диаграмата
errors.evidence: The yellow sector ("Решаване на спорове") is 26.2% according to the chart. The value 19.0% belongs to the orange sector ("Баланс на риска между страните"). The description swaps the values for the orange and yellow sectors.
The gray sector corresponds to "Условия за плащане" (Payment terms) according to the legend. "Законодателна рамка" (Legislative framework) is the blue sector.

The chart does not show a percentage value for the gray sector. The value 14.3% is the calculated sum of the two unlabeled sectors (gray and light blue), but assigning it to the gray sector alone is a hallucination.

errors.text_span: Вътре в секторите са поставени проценти.
errors.evidence: This statement implies all sectors have percentage labels inside them, but two of the five sectors (the gray and light blue ones) do not have percentage labels.
